_comment: F-16 training curricula. Popup text is fixed doctrine; geometry and threats are seeded at build time from difficulty profiles.

sead_viper.briefing_situation: A scripted SEAD training sortie over range airspace. Follow the route; instructions appear at each phase gate.
sead_viper.briefing_objective: Complete each phase as briefed. Suppress all assigned SAM sites along the route.

messages.intro:
HTS / HARM TRAINING

Loadout: 4x AGM-88, AIM-120C on wingtips only, HTS on station 10.
AG master mode. Sensor select toggles HTS (6) vs TGP.

Fly the route. Briefings will appear as you reach each phase.
messages.phase1_hts:
PHASE 1 — HTS SEARCH

Master mode AG. Press 6 for HTS (not HARM yet).
DTK on the left DED: set range scale with DEP/RTN if the picture is empty.
Fly toward the route — emitters appear as symbols when their radars are active.
Cursor over a symbol: read the emitter line on the DED.
messages.phase2_handoff:
PHASE 2 — HANDOFF & SHACK

With HTS cursor on a live emitter:
  • TMS FWD (short) = handoff to HARM seeker
  • Switch to HARM (7), select HAS or POS as briefed
SHACK on the DED means the HARM has a valid seeker track — you may fire.
No SHACK = do not launch. Break turn, reposition, hand off again.
messages.site_complete_rearm:
SITE COMPLETE — REARMING

SAM site is down. Your HARM load is being replenished.
Continue to the next training area on the route.
messages.phase3_second_site:
PHASE 3 — NEXT SITE

Same flow: HTS (6) to build the picture, handoff, HARM (7), confirm SHACK, shoot.
Multiple emitters? Cursor the track radar first, then mop up launchers.
messages.training_complete:
TRAINING COMPLETE

All assigned sites suppressed. You now have the full HTS-to-HARM chain:
HTS picture → handoff → SHACK → launch.
RTB when ready.

jdam_viper.briefing_situation: A scripted JDAM training sortie. Destroy supply targets along the route; point-defense threats guard each objective.
jdam_viper.briefing_objective: Complete each phase as briefed. Destroy all assigned targets with GBU-38 JDAM.

messages.intro:
JDAM TRAINING

Loadout: 4x GBU-38, AIM-120C on wingtips, Litening TGP on station 10.
Master mode AG. Sensor select toggles TGP (5).

Fly the route. Briefings appear at each phase gate.
messages.phase1_route:
PHASE 1 — INGRESS

Fly the route at briefed altitude.
TGP (5): verify the target area as you approach.
Check MAN page: confirm JDAM program and desired TOT if using CNTL.
messages.phase2_designate:
PHASE 2 — DESIGNATE & RELEASE

TGP on the target:
  • Cursor / slew crosshairs onto the aimpoint
  • TMS FWD (short) = designate (DMPI)
  • Select JDAM on SMS, confirm CNTL or VIS mode as briefed
  • Pickle when IN RNG and criteria met

Expect point defense near the target — plan egress before you pickle.
messages.target_complete:
TARGET COMPLETE

Target destroyed. Continue to the next objective on the route.
messages.phase3_next_target:
PHASE 3 — NEXT TARGET

Same flow: TGP designate → JDAM release → egress.
Re-acquire the next aimpoint before you commit.
messages.training_complete:
TRAINING COMPLETE

All assigned targets destroyed.
You have the full JDAM chain: TGP designate → weapon release → egress.
RTB when ready.

maverick_viper.briefing_situation: A scripted Maverick training sortie. Destroy vehicle targets along the route using TGP-assisted AGM-65 employment.
maverick_viper.briefing_objective: Complete each phase as briefed. Destroy all assigned targets with AGM-65 Maverick.

messages.intro:
MAVERICK TRAINING

Loadout: 4x AGM-65D, AIM-120C on wingtips, Litening TGP on station 10.
Master mode AG. Sensor select toggles TGP (5) vs Maverick (6).

Fly the route. Briefings appear at each phase gate.
messages.phase1_route:
PHASE 1 — INGRESS

Fly the route at briefed altitude.
TGP (5): acquire the target area visually before you commit.
messages.phase2_lock:
PHASE 2 — SLAVE, LOCK & LAUNCH

TGP on the target:
  • Slave Maverick to TGP (sensor select / handoff as briefed)
  • Switch to Maverick (6), confirm seeker on the aimpoint
  • Wait for solid lock (boxed target)
  • Launch, then crank away from point defense

Do not launch without a valid seeker track.
messages.target_complete:
TARGET COMPLETE

Target destroyed. Press inbound to the next objective.
messages.phase3_next_target:
PHASE 3 — NEXT TARGET

Same flow: TGP → Maverick lock → launch → egress.
messages.training_complete:
TRAINING COMPLETE

All assigned targets destroyed.
You have the Maverick chain: TGP slave → seeker lock → launch → egress.
RTB when ready.

cas_viper.briefing_situation: A scripted CAS training sortie. Friendly armor is in contact; destroy the enemy column while avoiding blue forces.
cas_viper.briefing_objective: Positive ID with TGP, then attack the enemy column with rockets. Do not fire on friendlies.

messages.intro:
CAS TRAINING

Loadout: Hydra rockets, AIM-120C on wingtips, Litening TGP on station 10.
Master mode AG. You are supporting friendly troops in contact (TIC).

Fly to the contact point. Briefings appear at each phase gate.
messages.phase1_contact:
PHASE 1 — CONTACT POINT

TGP (5): locate friendly positions (blue icons) and the enemy column.
Confirm geometry before you arm — friendlies are southwest of the enemy.
Call your run-in axis and stand off from SHORAD.
messages.phase2_attack:
PHASE 2 — ROCKET ATTACK

Master mode AG, rockets selected.
CCIP reticle on enemy vehicles — confirm no friendlies under the reticle.
Ripple rockets, then climb and turn cold from the threat.
messages.training_complete:
TRAINING COMPLETE

Enemy column destroyed. You completed a basic CAS TIC: ID with TGP, attack, egress.
RTB when ready.

cap_viper.briefing_situation: A scripted CAP training sortie. Hold your station and intercept inbound bandits before they reach friendly airspace.
cap_viper.briefing_objective: Establish CAP on station, identify inbound groups, and destroy hostile aircraft with AIM-120.

messages.intro:
CAP TRAINING

Loadout: AIM-120C missiles. Air-to-air master mode.
You are holding a CAP station between friendly and enemy territory.

Fly to station. Briefings appear as threats approach.
messages.phase1_cap:
PHASE 1 — CAP STATION

Hold the briefed racetrack.
RWS/TWS: search the picture forward of the threat axis.
Report any groups to GCI (simulated — you are cleared to engage HOSTILE tracks).
messages.phase2_commit:
PHASE 2 — COMMIT & ENGAGE

Bandits inbound:
  • Confirm ID (HOSTILE)
  • Commit when inside briefed MAR
  • AIM-120 select, shoot, crank for support

One engagement at a time — keep tally on the bandit formation.
messages.training_complete:
TRAINING COMPLETE

Bandits destroyed. You held CAP, committed on cue, and employed AIM-120.
RTB when ready.

escort_viper.briefing_situation: A scripted escort training sortie. Protect the strike package en route to the target area.
escort_viper.briefing_objective: Stay with the strike package, engage inbound interceptors, and bring the package through the threat area.

messages.intro:
ESCORT TRAINING

Loadout: AIM-120C missiles.
You are escorting a friendly strike package to the target area.

Join on the package and stay within visual/support range.
messages.phase1_escort:
PHASE 1 — JOIN-UP

Fall in on the strike package.
Maintain formation — do not outrun the bombers.
Your job is threat reaction, not leading the attack.
messages.phase2_engagement:
PHASE 2 — THREAT REACTION

Interceptors inbound toward the package:
  • Engage beyond the package if possible
  • Crank after each shot to keep SA on the second bandit
  • Package continues — do not chase deep into enemy airspace
messages.training_complete:
TRAINING COMPLETE

Interceptors defeated. The package is through the threat area.
RTB with the strikers when ready.
